name: Fiverr International Ltd.
blurb: Fiverr International Ltd. operates an online marketplace that connects freelancers with businesses seeking digital services. Its platform offers a wide range of services including logo design, blog writing, video creation, website development, and social media marketing. The company also provides value-added services such as Fiverr Ads and Seller Plus. As of early 2026, Fiverr holds a market cap of approximately $405 million and has shown revenue growth of 5.9% year-over-year.
recent: In the past 30 days, FVRR reported earnings on April 29, 2026, with net income up 57.5% year-over-year. The stock has traded in a 52-week range of $9.67 to $34.13, closing at $11.26 on May 6, 2026. Analysts maintain a Buy rating with a price target of $18.43, implying a 63.68% upside.
